explanation_hinglish: Parallel pair ka resistance (12×6)/(12+6) = 4 Ω hai. Isliye total resistance 6+4 = 10 Ω aur total current 24/10 = 2.4 A hai. Parallel pair par voltage 2.4×4 = 9.6 V hoga. Toh 12 Ω branch mein 9.6/12 = 0.8 A aur 6 Ω branch mein 9.6/6 = 1.6 A chalega; dono ka sum 2.4 A hai. Poore circuit ki energy E = VIt = 24×2.4×300 = 17280 J.
reference_error: Original worked solution ne parallel resistors ko series maan liya, isliye 24 Ω aur 1 A galat hain. Local proposed correction mein branch currents ulte assign hue hain: 12 Ω mein 0.8 A aur 6 Ω mein 1.6 A sahi hain.
